# S.C Roofing Ltd

> Roofing contractors based in Peasedown St John, near Bath, working across Bath, North East Somerset and nearby towns since 2004. Roof repairs, new roofs, flat roofs, chimneys, leadwork and guttering. NFRC Trade Member, NFRC Competent Person Scheme (pitched roofing) and Velux Certified Installer. Fully insured, 500+ roofs completed, rated 5 stars on Google.

- Company: S. C. Roofing Limited (Companies House 09717871); run by Shane Callinan
- Address: Delys, Eckweek Road, Peasedown St John, Bath BA2 8EQ
- Phone: 07881 903 188 (Mon–Fri 8am–5pm, Sat 8am–1pm)
- Email: info@scroofing.co.uk
- Guarantees: up to 20–25 years on flat roof systems, depending on the material

## Areas covered

Bath (including Combe Down, Bear Flat, Widcombe, Odd Down, Twerton, Weston, Larkhall, Bathampton and Batheaston), Keynsham, Saltford, Bitton, Longwell Green, Radstock, Midsomer Norton, Peasedown St John, Paulton, Norton St Philip, Frome, Trowbridge, Shepton Mallet and Wells.
